increment_paragraph: **GATE-ELASTIC (seam E; user decisions 4 and 5).** A delegated card now closes on the scoped card gate and the integrator runs the unchanged full standing gate once per landing (docs/agents/validation.md, with operations.md and AGENTS.md deferring to it). scripts/gate_scope.py --base <rev> maps the diff (both sides of renames, plus uncommitted paths) to crates of both workspaces through cargo metadata, closes over reverse dependencies, gives a path to every crate that compiles it in by include_str!/include_bytes!/include!/#[path] (found by scanning, 130 cross-crate rows, the read file's directory belonging to the reader as CT-FIXTURE-EXTERNAL-READERS asks) or names it in a run-time string literal, and runs fmt, Clippy and run_test_binaries.py --packages on that set (whole suite when the diff reaches qcore-c-gateway, qcore-core, qcore-contract or qcore-schemas, a manifest, the runner, the scoper or an unclassified unread path), the reevaluation examples when qcore-compiler is affected, gate_lean.py on changed modules, importers and their audits (all of check_lean_audits.py on a root change), the Python suite and the provider gate when providers/ changes, recording every exit, count and log in gate.json. run_test_binaries.py gains --packages with its EXCLUSIVE phase and fail-closed checks unchanged. scripts/gate_slot.py replaces the single lock with flock slots under /tmp/quirin-gate: rust-suite 1 (holding every audit slot), audit max(1, floor(MemAvailable/budget)) at 7 GiB default or 5/4 GiB, the budget passed to the audit's MiB planning budget, and lean 2; every slot job holds the legacy lock shared, so legacy and slot jobs exclude each other. Measured selection: docs, scripts and editors select no crate; examples and CT fixtures select qcore-compiler and qcorec; a non-core crate selects 5-6 of 13 root members because two tests walk crates/; proof/QCore, providers/, tests/support and the four core crates select the full suite. The card's own diff selects full mode and Lean all, so its gate is the standing gate: 549 units, 562 summaries, 8,639 passed, 0 failed, 15 ignored; 370 Lean 4.35.0 audits; 428 Python tests; fmt, Clippy and both examples exit 0. A live slot demonstration never got the legacy lock behind other cards' jobs and was stopped; slot accounting rests on real-flock tests. No analyzer, contract or Lean change.
status_paragraph: Gate policy (user decisions 4 and 5, 2026-10-24; card GATE-ELASTIC): a delegated card closes on the scoped card gate (scripts/gate_scope.py --base <rev>, gate.json in its report); the integrator runs the unchanged full standing gate once per landing and it stays the arbiter. Heavy jobs take named slots (scripts/gate_slot.py: rust-suite 1 and holding every audit slot, audit max(1, floor(MemAvailable/budget)) at 7 GiB default or 5/4 GiB, lean 2), interlocked with the legacy lock /tmp/qcore-c-card-validation-20261022.lock during the transition.

ledger.title: The scoped card gate finds run-time readers by a string-literal heuristic: it over-selects for broad walkers and cannot see data-derived paths or filtered whole-repository walks
ledger.why: scripts/gate_scope.py (card GATE-ELASTIC) finds compile-time readers exactly (include_str!/include_bytes!/include!/#[path], 130 cross-crate rows, one unresolvable include that is text inside a string), but run-time readers only by string literals naming a tracked path or a parent directory. Measured consequence (docs/reports/gate-elastic/selection.json): workspace_layering.rs (.join("crates")) and composition_bounds.rs (walks crates/) put qcore-compiler, qcore-verification and their dependents into the scope of every crate change (5-6 of 13 root members), and production_symbolic_adoption.rs (walks providers/) sends every providers/ change to qcore-contract and so the full suite. It cannot see a path a test computes from data (a manifest entry) or a whole-repository walk filtered afterwards (qcore-contract bounds_contract.rs, compiler tracked_inputs.rs), so the full gate per landing stays the arbiter. DISCHARGE: declare each repository walk's filter where it is made (for example a reviewed table of walker, root and extension the scoper reads, with a test that every tracked_files call outside a crate's own directory is listed), then measure the scope gain against selection.json.

ledger.title: qcore-provider-conformance dev-depends on six core crates, but neither the full gate nor the scoped gate runs the provider suite on a core-only change
ledger.why: cargo metadata (card GATE-ELASTIC): providers/conformance dev-depends on qcore-audit, qcore-c-gateway, qcore-contract, qcore-core, qcore-verification and qcore-verifier-host, and every provider member depends on qcore-schemas. The full standing gate runs the provider gate only when providers/ changes (constraint 18, operations card briefs), and the scoped gate follows it, listing such members in gate.json under provider_members_reached_without_providers_change. A core change can therefore break provider conformance with every gate green until a later providers/ change. DISCHARGE: decide whether a diff reaching a provider member through a core dependency runs the provider gate (scoped gate and landing gate alike), and record the decision in validation.md.

ledger.title: fmt, Clippy and cargo builds take no gate slot, so another card's build can load the host beside a rust-suite job's EXCLUSIVE phase
ledger.why: scripts/gate_slot.py (card GATE-ELASTIC) defines rust-suite, audit and lean classes; a rust-suite job excludes audits but nothing excludes another card's Clippy or test build while its EXCLUSIVE phase runs constraint 16's load-sensitive rows. Under the legacy lock every heavy step was serialised, so this load path opens as cards move to slots. DISCHARGE: either give builds a class the rust-suite class excludes during its EXCLUSIVE phase only, or measure the load-sensitive rows under a concurrent build and record that they hold.

ledger.title: providers/tests/*.py (25 tests) are run by no gate step
ledger.why: The standing gate runs python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests; providers/README.md's provider gate runs package.py, cargo test, fmt and Clippy. providers/tests/test_contract_load_path.py and test_package_contracts.py (25 tests, measured passing in 81.9 s by card GATE-ELASTIC on its tip) are in neither, although the pluggable-cards plan names the first as part of the provider suite that stayed red for a day. DISCHARGE: add python3 -m unittest discover -s providers/tests to the provider gate block (and the scoped gate's mirror), or record why it stays out.

ledger.title: task_context.py lists the full gate and the scoped card gate as one undifferentiated block of required commands
ledger.why: scripts/task_context.py extracts every ```sh block of docs/agents/validation.md; after card GATE-ELASTIC that is the full gate's commands followed by the scoped gate's command, with no statement that a card runs the latter and the integrator the former. DISCHARGE: label each extracted block with its heading (or emit only the gate the caller's role needs), with a test.

ledger.title: Every gate slot holds the legacy validation lock shared until no card uses it
ledger.why: During the transition (card GATE-ELASTIC) every scripts/gate_slot.py job holds /tmp/qcore-c-card-validation-20261022.lock shared, so `flock <legacy lock>` jobs and slot jobs exclude each other; a legacy exclusive waiter can wait indefinitely while slot jobs keep the lock shared. DISCHARGE: once no running brief names the legacy lock, remove the interlock from gate_slot.py and its tests, and the transition sentence from validation.md.

ledger.title: No scoped (non-full) gate run, gate_lean.py against Lake, or live slot job has completed yet
ledger.why: Card GATE-ELASTIC's own diff selects full mode, so its gate exercised gate_scope.py's full path only; the live demonstration of gate_slot.py rust-suite with run_test_binaries.py --packages qcorec,quirin-audit-plugin-libevent and of gate_slot.py lean with gate_lean.py waited about four hours behind legacy-lock jobs and was stopped (logs in that worktree's private/ge/demo*-attempt/). The restricted runner, slot accounting and gate_lean's refusals are covered by unit tests with real flock locks, not by a completed run. DISCHARGE: the first card that lands on the scoped gate in scoped mode with a Lean module step, under slots, publishes its gate.json and slot receipts, and its totals are checked against the units its --packages selection should build.

ledger.text: Card GATE-ELASTIC (2026-10-24): scripts/gate_scope.py now finds include_str!/include_bytes!/include!/#[path] readers mechanically and gives a read file's directory to the reading crate (gate_scope.py --readers; docs/reports/gate-elastic/readers.json), which keeps the scoped card gate from missing a cross-crate fixture reader. It is crate-granular, so it does not discharge this entry: the CT directories read from outside ct_corpus.rs are all inside qcore-compiler, and the requested check over those includes is still unbuilt.
